target_customer: Marketing and growth teams at brands that want to appear in ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity and Claude answers
problem: Brands do not know which content drives AI answers and cannot produce it at scale, so AI search sends them less traffic.
business_model: B2B SaaS subscription, monthly billing, free trial

founders.name: Jochen Madler
education: Valedictorian of a German finance program (institution not named)

competitors.name: Peec AI
competitors.what: AI search data turned into action list

technical_complexity.rationale: Tracking prompts across several models and generating content through an agent is standard engineering with scale and data collection challenges.

defensibility.rationale: Many GEO tools exist and monitoring is easy to copy; acting on recommendations may add some stickiness.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: SEO suites such as Semrush and Ahrefs offered AI visibility modules by 2026 per roundups.

market_need_then: AI answers redirected shopping research; a market estimate of about $1.09B for GEO in 2026 was cited by a roundup. Case study gains are company reported.

branding.domain_note: Uses sitefire.ai (.ai TLD); earlier LinkedIn handle gpt-pulse suggests a prior name

rebrands.from: GPT Pulse (inferred from YC page LinkedIn handle)
rebrands.why: Not stated; search found no confirmation.

branding.community_and_virality: Featured in Product Hunt (Feb 2026), a Launch HN, and a VentureBeat GEO roundup

brand_strength.rationale: Compound name is memorable and spellable, with launch coverage, but Sitefire and similar names (Sitegeist, Sitewire) are easy to confuse.

pivots.why: Per a startup spotlight, customers began asking ChatGPT for buying advice; the date is not given.

outcome_analysis: Sitefire is a two person Winter 2026 company with named enterprise clients and launch press, and no exit. It pivoted into a hot but crowded category, so the tailwind helps while differentiation and incumbent SEO suites are the main risks.
notes: Funding aggregators disagree and no company or press source confirms any round, so no round is recorded. VCBacked and PitchBook list about $500K pre-seed March 2026 with Y Combinator, Rebel Fund and Team Ignite Ventures; none confirmed by a company announcement. Neuronfeed labels it a January 2026 seed. Rename from GPT Pulse is inferred and unconfirmed.
